accountBadEmail: Wannan baya kama da adireshin imel.
accountCodeSent: Lambar da aka aika. Duba imel ɗin ku.
accountDone: Asusun da aka kirkiro. An adana harsunan ku.
accountFailed: Wannan bai yi aiki ba. Da fatan za a sake gwada.
accountSub: Ana kiyaye yaren karatun ku da harshen taken ku, don haka ba ku sake saita su ba.
capEmpty: Babu abin da aka fada tukuna.
capNotice: Abin da aka faɗi a cikin wannan Salon an rubuta shi kuma an adana shi don a iya fassara shi. Kowa a nan zai iya karanta shi cikin yaren da ya zaba.
connFailSub: Haɗin zuwa Salon ya gaza. Duba hanyar sadarwar ku kuma sake gwada.
connectedSub: Tattaunawar tana gudana. Yi magana da kyauta.
consoleLeaves: Buɗe na'urar wasan bidiyo zai kawo karshen shiga cikin wannan Salon. Ci gaba?
errConnDetail: Kuskuren da ba a tsammani ya faru.
errDetail: Wataƙila an riga an yi amfani da wannan hanyar haɗin, ko ya ƙare.
errIncompleteDetail: Wannan haɗin haɗin haɗin ba cikakke ba.
errLinkDetail: Wannan hanyar haɗin ba ta da inganci, an riga an yi amfani da shi, ko kuma ya ƙare.
errNetDetail: Ba za a iya isa uwar garken ba. Duba haɗin ku.
info1: Amintaccen damar baƙi - babu asusun da ake buƙata
info2: Babu abin da za a shigarwa - duk a cikin burauzar ku
info3: Tattaunawar sauti ta hanyar Vocaliz AI
micBlocked: An toshe makirufo - ba da izinin shi daga gunkin a cikin sandar adireshin
micBlockedStill: Har yanzu an toshe. Ba da izinin makirufo a cikin saitunan shafin mai binciken ku, sannan sake danna maɓallin. Idan aikace-aikacen imel ɗin ku ya buɗe wannan shafin, sake buɗe hanyar haɗin a cikin Safari ko Chrome - haɗin har yanzu yana aiki.
micOffStill: Har yanzu babu makirufo. Bincika cewa babu wani app ɗin da ke amfani da shi, sannan sake matsa.
readySub: Vocaliz yana buƙatar samun damar zuwa makirufo don ku iya shiga cikin tattaunawar.
whatIsVocaliz: Vocaliz dandamali ne don ƙirƙirar Salons. A cikin Salon, mutane da wakilin muryar AI suna tattauna shafin yanar gizo ko takarda tare.
